<module id="multi_pipe_8bit">
    <description>Design an 8-bit unsigned multiplier using pipelined processing. Implement sequential logic for generating partial products and calculating the final product. Use the provided template and follow the guidelines for naming conventions and documentation.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="mul_en_in">Input enable signal controlling multiplication operation.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">Multiplicand input with a width of 8 bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">Multiplier input with a width of 8 bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_en_out">Output enable signal indicating completion of multiplication operation.</output>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[15:0]">Product output with a width of 16 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH_A" value="8">Width of multiplicand input.</parameter>
        <parameter id="WIDTH_B" value="8">Width of multiplier input.</parameter>
        <parameter id="WIDTH_OUT" value="16">Width of product output.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="mul_en_out_reg" width_description="[1:0]">Register to hold input enable signal.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_a_reg" width_description="[WIDTH_A-1:0]">Register to hold multiplicand input.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_b_reg" width_description="[WIDTH_B-1:0]">Register to hold multiplier input.</reg>
        
        <wire id="temp[0]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold partial product for bit 0.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[1]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold partial product for bit 1.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[2]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold partial product for bit 2.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[3]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold partial product for bit 3.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[4]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold partial product for bit 4.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[5]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold partial product for bit 5.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[6]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold partial product for bit 6.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[7]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Wire to hold partial product for bit 7.</wire>
        
        <reg id="sum[0]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold partial sum for bit 0.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[1]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold partial sum for bit 1.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[2]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold partial sum for bit 2.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[3]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold partial sum for bit 3.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[4]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold partial sum for bit 4.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[5]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold partial sum for bit 5.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[6]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold partial sum for bit 6.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[7]" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold partial sum for bit 7.</reg>
        
        <reg id="mul_out_reg" width_description="[WIDTH_OUT-1:0]">Register to hold final product.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block triggered on positive edge of clk
        always @(posedge clk) begin
            // Assigning input enable signal to register on positive edge of clk
            mul_en_out_reg <= {mul_en_out_reg[0], mul_en_in};
            
            // Conditional assignment based on input enable signal
            if(mul_en_out_reg[0]) begin
                // Assigning multiplicand input to register on positive edge of clk
                mul_a_reg <= mul_a;
                
                // Assigning multiplier input to register on positive edge of clk
                mul_b_reg <= mul_b;
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic for generating partial products
        genvar i;
        generate
            for(i = 0; i < WIDTH_B; i=i+1) begin : gen_partial_products
                assign temp[i][0] = mul_a_reg[0] & mul_b_reg[i];
                assign temp[i][1] = mul_a_reg[1] & mul_b_reg[i];
                assign temp[i][2] = mul_a_reg[2] & mul_b_reg[i];
                assign temp[i][3] = mul_a_reg[3] & mul_b_reg[i];
                assign temp[i][4] = mul_a_reg[4] & mul_b_reg[i];
                assign temp[i][5] = mul_a_reg[5] & mul_b_reg[i];
                assign temp[i][6] = mul_a_reg[6] & mul_b_reg[i];
                assign temp[i][7] = mul_a_reg[7] & mul_b_reg[i];
            end
        endgenerate
        
        // Sequential logic for adding partial products
        always @(posedge clk) begin
            // Adding first two partial products and storing result in sum register
            sum[0] <= temp[0] + temp[1];
            
            // Adding next four partial products and storing result in sum register
            sum[1] <= temp[2] + temp[3] + temp[4] + temp[5];
            
            // Adding last two partial products and storing result in sum register
            sum[2] <= temp[6] + temp[7];
            
            // Adding remaining partial products and storing result in sum register
            sum[3] <= temp[0] + temp[1] + temp[2] + temp[3] + temp[4] + temp[5] + temp[6] + temp[7];
        end
        
        // Sequential logic for calculating final product
        always @(posedge clk) begin
            // Adding all partial sums and storing result in mul_out_reg register
            mul_out_reg <= sum[0] + sum[1] + sum[2] + sum[3];
        end
        
        // Assigning output enable signal based on input enable signal
        assign mul_en_out = mul_en_out_reg[1];
        
        // Assigning output product based on input enable signal
        assign mul_out = mul_en_out ? mul_out_reg : 0;
    </implementation>
</module>
